Unified send endpoint. Accepts multipart/form-data so the caller can include file attachments. Recipients may be a comma- or semicolon-separated list. If omitted, the configured fallback ToEmail is used.
Authentication: send the registered app's API key in the X-Api-Key header (or as an ApiKey form field).

member.name: M:EmailApi.Controllers.EmailController.SendAiEmail(EmailApi.Models.SendAiEmailRequest)
member.summary:
Send an email using a simple JSON payload — designed for AI tools, webhooks, and external integrations. Accepts application/json so it works out-of-the-box with Gemini function calling, OpenAI Actions, Claude tools, fetch(), and axios.
Authentication: send your registered app's API key via the X-Api-Key header. Alternatively, include an apiKey field in the JSON body.
Recipients can be specified via recipients (array), recipient, to, email, or recipientEmail — all are accepted.
Templates can be referenced by numeric ID, numeric string, or template name. Template values are used as defaults; any explicit field overrides the template.
member.param: JSON body with email content, recipients, and optional template reference.
member.response: Validation error — missing recipient, subject, body, or invalid template.
Email sending failed due to an SMTP or server error.
